In Revelation, where it occurs most frequently, it structures the heavenly scene: four living creatures around the throne (Rev 4:6), four angels at the four corners of the earth (Rev 7:1), and four horns of the golden altar (Rev 9:13). The Attic form tettares and Ionic tesseres are absent from the NT, which consistently uses the Koine tessares."
